findings.issue: The8.006W external power is the nominal PI design-equation value, while9.180–9.630W input and82.49–86.53% efficiency use the surrogate7.944W LED load. The difference is small and both are legitimate approximations, but the summary field names do not explicitly distinguish the two bases.
findings.consequence: A reader could incorrectly subtract8.006W from the surrogate input estimate and think the loss budget is inconsistent by0.062W.
findings.closure_condition: Label the design-equation output versus surrogate output/input/efficiency basis in the final user summary or add a separate explanatory note. No hardware modification is necessary.
